Acme Robotics Signs $20 Million Supply Agreement with Walmart

Three-year agreement for autonomous warehouse robots

NEW YORK, Sept. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acme Robotics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACMR) today announced that it has signed a definitive three-year supply agreement with Walmart Inc. valued at $20 million.

“This is our largest order to date,” said the CEO.
